messages:
Kara: quick heads-up — during the canary deploy I noticed a debug log line in staging that contains a full DB query with the user's raw prompt. not credentials but user content might be sensitive.
Omar: can you paste the exact log line and path? staging or prod?
Kara: staging only, under /var/log/redwood/audit.log. excerpt: 
```
2028-11-10T14:21:03Z [DEBUG] query=SELECT * FROM conversations WHERE user_id=123 AND prompt='\"transfer $500 to mom\"' /* trace=abc123 */\n
```
Kara: the prompt was interpolated into the query string by a legacy debug helper.
SRE-bot: deploy:canary finished for service=ingest (rev=ingest@f2d). log-shipper status: healthy.
Natalie: tagging for security triage — do we know retention window for that audit.log on staging? any backups replicated?
Kara: retention is 30d for staging, and that file was rotated hourly. don't think backups push to S3 but will confirm.
Omar: run `sudo grep -n "prompt='" /var/log/redwood/audit.log*` and attach a count. also snapshot current file before we purge.
Kara: running now, got ~7 matches across last 24h. snapshot saved to /tmp/incident-1865432100-snap.gz
Liam: if staging only, customers probably not affected, but if any export or debug bundle was created we should check if it was shared with support. I shared a note in support-runbook.
Natalie: immediate actions: (1) rotate any debug-only tokens? none used here. (2) purge the snapshot from staging hosts and from any collection buckets. (3) run access audit to see who downloaded the snapshot.
Kara: purged snapshot from staging host and removed temp copies. S3 check: no matching objects found.
Omar: I ran `aws s3api list-objects` for the debug-bucket prefix — zero. also confirmed no support attachments in last 24h referencing staging logs.
Natalie: good. next: patch the code to stop interpolating prompts and switch to parameterized queries + redact before logging. can someone submit a quick PR?
Kara: opening PR now: https://github.com/redwood/ingest/pull/482 — small change in helpers/logging.go to use `params` and `redactPrompt()`
SRE-bot: CI queued for PR #482 — tests: unit, lint, integration.
Omar: assign reviewers @Natalie and @Liam. target deploy to staging after CI passes, do not promote to prod until we confirm no prod exposure.
legal-escalations: quick note from legal — if this is strictly staging and no customer data was exported, we can treat as internal incident. if any customer PII was present or pulled into a support bundle, escalate and consider notifications. please keep a timeline and list of artifacts accessed.
Liam: I'll check support ticket attachments and run a search for the snapshot filename.
Kara: timeline gist: 14:15 deploy, 14:20 canary logs show raw prompt, 14:23 flagged here, 14:30 snapshot made, 14:35 snapshot purged, 14:45 S3 verified. PR opened 14:50.
Natalie: please add that timeline to the incident doc and tag me. I'll do an access audit (who had sudo/ssh to canary hosts) and report back within 2h.
Omar: sounds good. for comms — no external message needed now. once Natalie confirms no backup/external access and legal signs off we can close with an internal RCA and the code fix.
Kara: thanks — will keep updates here. /cc @legal-escalations for final sign-off before we close. :thumbsup:
legal-escalations: acknowledged — will review the access audit when ready. if anything changes (prod exposure or support share) we'll escalate to customer-notify path.
